name: 70mai Dash Cam 4K Omni 360 Full View with Dual Sony STARVIS 2, AI 2.0 & 4G LTE Supported

attributes.tagline: The Next-Gen 360° Dash Cam with Dual Brilliance
attributes.promo: Buy One get One accessory pack free: Add the 4K Omni accessory pack into cart.

description:
• Dual-Channel Recording with 4K Image Quality: Capture crystal-clear 4K footage from the front camera (Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678 sensor) and 1080P from the rear, both with HDR support. Experience smooth 4K 60FPS* recording for detailed and fluid video even at high speeds.

  • Immersive 360° Full-View: With a 360° rotating design powered by dual Hall Effect sensors and the equipped magnetic system, the 4K Omni delivers precise lens positioning and flawless rotating, ensuring zero blind spots while doubling as a fun travel vlog recorder to capture every moment of your journey.

  • Enhanced Night Vision and Parking Surveillance: 70mai Night Owl Vision and Lumi Vision technologies ensure clear recordings in low-light conditions while driving and parked. AI Motion Detection 2.0 with dual Hall Effect sensors provides accurate tracking and recording of potential incidents.

  • Comprehensive Parking Protection: Dual-channel collision detection and time-lapse recording activate the front and rear cameras in parking mode. 4G compatibility enables instant app alerts, car location, live route tracking, and app live streaming for remote monitoring.

  • Advanced Safety Features: Buffered emergency recording captures crucial footage before, during, and after an incident. Built-in GPS tracks speed, time, and location. Super-sensing ADAS provides lane departure, forward collision, and other driver-assistance warnings.

  • Reliable Power and Storage: A built-in supercapacitor ensures reliable operation and a long lifespan in extreme temperatures. Battery voltage monitoring prevents car battery drain. Supports up to 512GB of external storage for ample recording capacity.

  • Smart Connectivity and User Experience: Wi-Fi 6 (5GHz) enables fast file transfers. Voice control (multiple languages) and the MaiX in-car AI mate provide hands-free operation and interactive features.

  • High-Speed Transfer: Download speeds up to 20MB/s with Wi-Fi 6 5GHz.

  • Additional Features: Road Story Filter adds driving data and effects to footage for sharing.

*4K 60FPS is exclusive to single-channel mode, while dual-channel mode supports up to 4K 30FPS.

name: 70mai Dash Cam 4K T800 3-Channel w/ Dual 4K, STARVIS 2 IMX678, HDR Night Vision, AI Detection, Emergency Record, 4G LTE & Supercapacitor
description:
• Dual Sony STARVIS 2 Technology: Feature larger pixel size for enhanced light capture, delivering sharper, more detailed footage even in low-light settings.
  • 70mai Night Owl Vision: 70mai's exclusive technology that produces clearer nighttime images with less noise, balanced exposure, and improved glare control.
  • Dual 4K 3-Channel: The 4K T800 combines a space-saving integrated front and interior camera with a rear camera, delivering comprehensive 3-angle views to virtually eliminate blind spots.
  • Supercapacitor Solution: Withstands extreme working temperatures and boasts a long lifespan of charging cycles.
  • 4G LTE Connectivity*: Ensure uninterrupted communication with your vehicle from any location. (*The 70mai 4G Hardwire Kit is required and sold separately.)
  • 3-Channel HDR Recording: The 4K T800 supports HDR recording across all three channels, stably capturing highlight-shadow details to deliver an enhanced dynamic range.
  • Smart Parking Guardian Mode*: Feature AI Motion Detection, Collision Detection & Time-Lapse Recording, triggering all three cameras to record suspicious activity or impact, while capturing continuous footage at 1 FPS to save storage. (*The 70mai Hardwire Kit is required and sold separately.)
  • Buffered Emergency Recording: Capture up to 3 minutes of pre-collision, the impact, and 30 seconds after, ensuring no vital evidence is missed in case of sudden impact or emergency.
  • Battery Voltage Monitoring: Provide 24/7 status, 9 levels of protection against drain, and remote/auto low-voltage power-off.
  • 70mai Lumi Vision for Parking: An industry-first technology designed to ensure clear visibility around the vehicle in near-total darkness.
  • Super-Sensing ADAS: Warn you in advance to avoid traffic safety risks to provide an extra layer of safety for your journey.
  • Built-In GPS: Capture speed, time, and coordinates, seamlessly logged for review in the 70mai App, offering proof of travel and route optimization.
  • Voice Control: Beyond English and Mandarin, the 4K T800 now supports Japanese and Italian voice control. Use simple commands for photos/videos and audio on/off.
  • Picture-in-Picture Mode: The 4K T800 offers simultaneous front, rear, and interior footage on its screen, providing an omniscient, multi-angle view of your vehicle's surroundings for complete peace of mind.
  • MaiColor Vivid+ Solutionââ€? An exclusive algorithm that enhances image quality with Auto Exposure Technology for natural balance, Selective Image Processing for key details, and Windshield Compensation for accurate color and transparency.
  • 4K 60FPS: Capture every detail with unrivaled clarity and enjoy ultra-smooth motion for a truly cinematic driving experience. (*4K 60FPS is exclusive to single-channel mode.)

name: 70mai Micro SD Card for Dash Cam
description:

  • The 32G and 64G variants are compatible with the following dashcams: Dash Cam 3, 1S, M300, Lite 2, A400, A500S, A800S, A810, A200, S500 and A510.

name: 70mai Battery Pack for Dash Cam
description:
Extended Parking Surveillance Duration: Seamlessly utilizes stored energy, ensuring uninterrupted surveillance while safeguarding your vehicle's battery life during parking.

Two Charging Setups: Cigarette lighter power for simplicity & hardwire connection for faster charging.

Extensive Compatibility*: Compatible with 70mai and most other dash cams with parking surveillance cables, ensuring seamless integration for various setups.

Automatic Current Limiting: Dynamically adjusts the charging current based on the charging method, preventing battery depletion.

Delayed Charging: Starts charging 20 seconds after vehicle startup, preventing excessive load on the battery.

Enhanced Battery Protection: Safeguards against temperature extremes, overcharge, short-circuit, and more for battery longevity.

*For Cigarette Lighter Solution, if you are using a third-party dash cam or 4G hardwire kit, You'll need the 70mai Parking Surveillance Cable Adapter to work with the battery pack.

name: 70mai Dash Cam 4K A900 Ultra – Flagship Dual 4K HDR Camera with Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678 Sensors

attributes.tagline: The Flagship of Dual 4K Vision. Every Frame Synced.

description:
Dual Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678 Sensors：Powered by dual Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678 sensors, A900 Ultra delivers flagship-level imaging performance for both front and rear cameras. With advanced sensor technology, it captures sharper details, clearer license plates, and more reliable road evidence in every driving scenario.

Dual True 4K HDR Recording：Experience true 4K HDR recording from both front and rear cameras. A900 Ultra delivers ultra-clear footage with balanced exposure and realistic details, while customizable image settings and smart HDR switching adapt to different lighting conditions.

LVDS Lossless Digital Transmission：Featuring an industry-first combination of Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678 and LVDS digital transmission, A900 Ultra preserves original image data without compression or quality loss. With ultra-low 20ms latency and a slim cable design, it delivers real-time rear 4K transmission with easier installation.

Smart Parking Guardian Mode 2.0：Upgraded with dual-channel monitoring, AI detection, and pre-recording technology, A900 Ultra provides comprehensive parking protection. It captures complete event details from both front and rear cameras, helping secure reliable evidence when your vehicle is unattended.

AI-Powered Imaging Enhancement：A900 Ultra combines 70mai Night Owl Vision™ 2.0, MaiColor Vivid+ Solution™ 2.0, and Lumi Vision™ technologies to deliver smarter image processing across driving and parking scenarios. From bright daylight to extreme darkness, it intelligently balances exposure, reduces noise, enhances details, and preserves critical evidence with exceptional clarity.

name: 70mai Dash Cam M310 Plus 4K
description:
Experience true 4K clarity in an ultra-compact, screenless dash cam designed to stay discreet and out of your line of sight. With enhanced low-light imaging, smart parking protection, and effortless app control, the M310 Plus 4K keeps every drive clearly covered—without the bulk or distraction.
Big 4K Performance：Record in true 4K to preserve finer details such as license plates and road signs. A 140° field of view captures more of the road ahead without excessive distortion.
Clearer Details After Dark：The wide f/1.55 aperture, Super Night Vision, and WDR work together to brighten dark scenes and balance exposure for clearer footage in tunnels, parking areas, and at night.
Compact, Screenless, and Flexible：The compact, screenless body stays discreet and out of your line of sight. Adjust the lens through 360°, while in-app flip and mirror settings keep footage correctly oriented.
Keep Watch While You’re Away：G-sensor collision detection automatically records a 30-second event clip. Time-lapse recording captures continuously at 1 FPS, compressing every 15 minutes into one minute to save storage space.
Capture More Than the Moment of Impact：Buffered Emergency Recording preserves up to 3 minutes 10 seconds before an incident and 30 seconds after, saving the footage in a dedicated Emergency folder for easy access.
Record Without Constant File Management：Loop Recording automatically replaces older standard clips. Emergency and parking videos are saved in separate folders and loop independently, helping protect important footage from regular-file overwriting.
Everything You Need, Right from Your Phone：
Connect through built-in Wi-Fi to preview footage, adjust settings, play back clips, and download videos directly in the 70mai App.
Stay Focused with Voice Control：
Use simple voice commands to control key functions without taking your hands off the wheel.
More Room for Every Journey：
Supports 16GB to 256GB microSD cards, providing more recording space for daily drives, long trips, and high-resolution 4K footage.
